The '''Bentora system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Samix sector/Legends|Samix sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the region known as [[Bentora Space]].<ref name="GNN">{{JournalCite|5|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Bentora system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square Q-19.<ref name="EAOC" />
